title: CLI argument parsing and TOML config loading
user_story: As an operator, I need to configure Hookbin via CLI flags or a TOML file so I can deploy it with my preferred settings without recompiling.
description: Implement the Config struct and CLI parsing using clap derive. Support all TigerBeetle-style bounds from CLAUDE.md as CLI flags with sane defaults. Optionally load a TOML config file that CLI flags override. Zero config by default — the binary runs with no flags.

acceptance_criteria.given: no CLI flags and no TOML file
acceptance_criteria.then: all defaults apply: port 3000, data dir ./hookbin-data, max-hooks 100, max-payload 1MB, retention 24h, rate-limit 60/min, max-requests 1000
port is 9090, data dir is /tmp/hb, max-hooks is 50, all other values are defaults

acceptance_criteria.given: a TOML file with `port = 7070` and a CLI flag `--port 9090`

acceptance_criteria.when: config is loaded with no CLI override

acceptance_criteria.then: a clear error message is printed to stderr and the process exits with code 1
a clear error about the missing file is printed and the process exits with code 1
unit tests verify default values, TOML parsing, and CLI-overrides-TOML precedence

functions.name: Config::load
functions.description: Parse CLI args, optionally load TOML, merge with CLI-wins precedence

single_binary_checklist.notes: Config parsing is pure logic. TOML crate is small. No network IO.
